You are working on Food Tracker, an Angular 20 + Supabase application with strict TypeScript and standalone components.

## Start Here

- Read README first for product and deployment context: [README.md](../README.md)
- Validate changes with:
  - npm run build
  - npm test -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless

## Required Project Workflow

- Always use the npm scripts, not direct ng commands, so environment sync runs first.
- Environment files are generated by scripts/sync-env.mjs.
- If environment-related failures occur, verify SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env files.

## Architecture Boundaries

- src/app/core: singleton services, guards, shared app models.
- src/app/auth: authentication pages.
- src/app/admin: admin-only feature pages and services.
- src/app/employee: employee feature pages and services.
- src/app/layout: app shell and navigation.
- src/app/shared/components: reusable UI building blocks.

## Angular Conventions

- Use standalone components. Do not add NgModules.
- Do not set standalone: true in decorators.
- Use ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush.
- Use inject() over constructor injection.
- Use signals and computed for local state.
- Do not use signal mutate; use set or update.
- Use native control flow: @if, @for, @switch.
- Prefer input() and output() functions over decorators.
- Prefer class and style bindings over ngClass and ngStyle.

## Component File Structure

- For new components, use separate files:
  - component.ts for logic
  - component.html for template
  - component.css or component.scss for styles
- Avoid large inline templates in TypeScript files.

## Forms and UI

- Prefer reactive forms with FormBuilder nonNullable groups.
- Keep forms typed and validation explicit.
- Use PrimeNG components and PrimeFlex utility classes consistently.

## Auth and Role Rules

- Role model supports multi-role users via profiles.roles with legacy compatibility through profiles.role.
- Use AuthService role helpers (hasRole, hasAnyRole, roles) instead of direct role string checks.
- Keep route access aligned with guards in src/app/core/guards.

## Data and Supabase

- Keep Supabase access in services, not directly in components.
- Preserve RLS compatibility when modifying queries or payloads.
- When changing role or profile behavior, check migrations under supabase/migrations and keep backward compatibility in mind.

## TypeScript Rules

- Keep strict typing.
- Avoid any. Use unknown when needed and narrow safely.
- Keep public API and model types in sync with app.models.ts.
